name: signer
description: Who may sign what in this skein. Holds the kernel service `signer` (the raw signer import) and serves it to other apps' NAMED in-VM calls (fn wallet, {frame: <BRC-100 request frame, calls 8 and 11-16>} → {frame: <result frame>} | {error}). Level 0 is open; level 1 is served under `1/<protocol>`; level 2 under `2/<protocol>/<counterparty: self | anyone | 66-hex key>`; a caller approved for any name calls under `*`. The identity key needs no name. Privileged requests are refused. Nothing prompts. Only the kernel's checked name (the call input's `as`) counts.
